source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: Should You Accuse Ju of Killing Her Sister?
source_excerpt:
Ju and Lanlan are among the first NPCs that players will come across before entering Thieves' Camp, and later find Lanlan dead and need to decide whether to accuse Ju of killing her in Phantom Blade Zero . This is a secret encounter that only happens once players complete the Crimson Forest part of the Secrets of Baishan Sect quest and return to the rope bridge near Thieves' Camp. Here are the outcomes of both choices and which one you should pick.
Should You Accuse Ju of Killing Her Sister in Phantom Blade Zero?
When players return to Thieves' Camp after finding junior sister Meng in the Secrets of Baishan Sect quest , they'll find that Lanlan has been killed and Ju is sitting near her body holding a blade. It seems that Ju really went along with the plan and got herself transformed into a Maskwalker.
After interacting with Ju, players will get the following options.
The dead cannot return. Mourn, and let go.
Here are the outcomes of both choices, so you can better decide whether to accuse Ju of killing her sister or not in Phantom Blade Zero .
What Happens if You Pick the "It Was You Who Killed Her" Dialog?
If you decide to accuse Ju of killing Lanlan, she'll go mad and fully transform into a mindless Mindwalker. Now, players will need to fight her over the rope bridge and defeat her. After successfully beating Ju, players will receive the "Seal of Dugu" accessory as a reward.
It's a great offensive accessory that players can use to deplete 8% more Sha-Chi gauge of enemies when hitting them with Sha-Chi attacks (Y/Triangle).
What Happens if You Pick the "The Dead Cannot Return. Mourn, and Let Go" Dialog?
If the players decide to ignore what she's done and let her go, nothing happens . Ju will just sit there, and you won't be able to talk to her anymore. It is implied that Ju will go to junior sister Meng and make her go through Transcension as well, but I didn't notice any changes to the narrative during my playthrough.
So, it's pretty clear that the best choice is to accuse Ju of killing her sister in Phantom Blade Zero , instead of just asking her to Mourn and let go. Accessories are a major collectible and count towards your overall region completion rate, so it won't make sense to miss out on one of them.
